title: 第1章 我是谁第2章 继续装傻
content_zh:
“傻子，让你换衣服。”
谁是傻子？华文悦一下子睁开眼睛，发现自己在一个完全陌生的屋子里。
刚才喊他傻子的是一个中年妇女，看上去像是家里的保姆。
华文悦感觉脑袋一阵剧烈的疼痛。
他想起来了，自己从国外乘飞机回国，飞机在公海上空出事，飞机坠毁，他已经死了，怎么会在这里？
中年妇女把一套新衣服扔在他面前的床上就走了。
华文悦脑袋没那么疼了，好多了。
一幕幕记忆像潮水般涌来，这个妇女是陈家的保姆，名叫阿珍，平日里对他很苛刻。
这里是江海市陈家，自己穿越了？穿越到陈家傻子陈景言身上了？
“我去，怎么回事？”
华文悦暗暗叫苦，一个金融圈让人敬畏的天之骄子，怎么会穿越到一个傻子身上了？
他站起来踉跄了一下，突然间感觉全身力量涌动，仿佛每个细胞都在重组。
每一寸骨骼都仿佛由星辰铸就，经脉如江河奔涌，蕴藏着毁天灭地的潜能。
他低头看着自己的双手，掌心纹路仿佛与天地脉络共鸣，一股古老而磅礴的气息自丹田升起。
这具身体看似痴傻，实则蕴藏千年未见的修行天赋——先天道体。
华文悦是夏国的天之骄子，闻名世界的投资天才。它拥有的财富数不胜数。钱对他来说就是一个数字。
如今却困在这具被世人耻笑的躯壳中，前世的财富与权势皆成泡影。
他虽然是投资天才，但在这个以武为尊的世界，他也抽空修炼，奈何他这方面的天赋太差，如今还只是个黄级武者，处于“天地玄黄”四阶中最低一级，黄级，而且只练到三级。属于黄级下品。
他对玄门修行早有涉猎，此刻感知到体内异变，心中震撼不已。
现在他附着的这个躯壳，恐怕早已突破天极，迈入传说中的神境。已经是一只脚踏入仙界。

他凝神内视，丹田处一缕金光流转，竟与夏国古籍记载的“破境通玄诀”隐隐呼应。
他到底是什么人，这么厉害的人，怎么是个傻子？
原主叫陈景言，今年二十六岁，华文悦努力回忆，只想到原主近三年的一些记忆碎片，其他的，一片空白。
他强忍震撼，缓缓闭上眼睛，试图梳理这些杂乱不堪的记忆。
这时，另一个佣人进来，对陈景言客气地说道：“少爷，该换衣服了，家主和你姐姐在等着你。吴家马上就到了，今天吴家来接你回家。”
什么吴家？陈景言有些糊涂了。但他想起来了，这个佣人姓张，陈景言一直喊她张嫂，她对陈景言很好。
“张嫂，我为什么要回吴家？吴家是什么人？”
张嫂告诉陈景言，吴家才是他的亲生父母，现在吴家来接他回去，明天就要让他嫁入柳家当赘婿。
华文悦心头一震，原来陈景言竟是吴家血脉，可他怎么又会在陈家？他这么厉害的人，怎么会变成傻子了？
这一切谜团如迷雾笼罩，却容不得他细想。
等张嫂出去以后，陈景言拿起新衣服一看，这衣服很普通，全身上下价值不超过三百块。
他指尖抚过衣角粗粝的线头，忽而冷笑。
他是华文悦身份的时候，拥有万贯家财，他穿的衣服都是特制高定，一针一线皆由大师亲手缝制，一套西服的价值在百万以上。
这粗布麻衣穿在身上，简直不堪入目。
但他现在很清楚，他已经困于痴傻之身，今后只能做个傻子。
content_en:
"Idiot, let me change your clothes."
Who is the fool? Hua Wenyue suddenly opened her eyes and found herself in a completely unfamiliar room.
The person who just called him a fool was a middle-aged woman who looked like the nanny at home.
Hua Wenyue felt a sharp pain in his head.
He remembered that he was on a plane returning to China from abroad, and the plane had an accident over the high seas. The plane crashed and he was dead. How could he be here?
The middle-aged woman threw a new set of clothes on the bed in front of him and left.
Hua Wenyue's head doesn't hurt so much anymore, it's much better.
Scenes of memories came flooding back. This woman was the Chen family's nanny, named Azhen, and she was usually very harsh on him.
This is the Chen family in Jianghai City. Have you traveled through time? Time traveled to Chen Jingyan, the fool of the Chen family?
"I'm going, what's going on?"
Hua Wenyue secretly complained, how could a proud man who was respected in the financial world time travel and be in the body of a fool?
He stood up and staggered, and suddenly felt a surge of strength throughout his body, as if every cell was being reorganized.
Every inch of his bones seemed to be made of stars, and his meridians surged like rivers, containing the potential to destroy the world.
He looked down at his hands. The lines on his palms seemed to resonate with the veins of heaven and earth, and an ancient and majestic aura rose from his dantian.
This body looks stupid, but in fact it contains a talent for cultivation that has not been seen in thousands of years - the innate Taoist body.
Hua Wenyue is the proud son of Xia Kingdom and a world-famous investment genius. Its wealth is countless. Money is just a number to him.
Now he is trapped in this body that is ridiculed by the world, and the wealth and power in his previous life are all in vain.
Although he is an investment genius, in this world where martial arts is respected, he still finds time to practice. However, his talent in this area is too poor. Now he is only a yellow-level warrior. He is at the lowest level of the fourth level of "Heaven and Earth Xuanhuang", the yellow level, and he has only practiced to the third level. Belongs to the lower grade yellow grade.
He had already dabbled in Xuanmen practice. At this moment, he felt the changes in his body and was shocked.
The body he is attached to now has probably already broken through the heavens and entered the legendary divine realm. He has already stepped into the fairyland with one foot.
He looked inside intently, and saw a ray of golden light flowing in his dantian, which vaguely echoed the "Jue of Breaking the Realm and Connecting the Mysterious" recorded in the ancient books of Xia Kingdom.
Who is he? How can such a powerful person be such a fool?
The original owner's name was Chen Jingyan, who was twenty-six years old this year. Hua Wenyue tried hard to recall, but could only think of some memory fragments of the original owner in the past three years, and the rest was blank.
He endured the shock and slowly closed his eyes, trying to sort out these messy memories.
At this time, another servant came in and said politely to Chen Jingyan: "Master, it's time to change clothes. The head of the house and your sister are waiting for you. The Wu family will be here soon. The Wu family will take you home today."
What Wu family? Chen Jingyan was a little confused. But he remembered that this servant's surname was Zhang. Chen Jingyan kept calling her Mrs. Zhang. She was very kind to Chen Jingyan.
"Sister-in-law Zhang, why should I go back to the Wu family? Who are the Wu family?"
Sister-in-law Zhang told Chen Jingyan that the Wu family were his biological parents. Now that the Wu family had come to take him back, they would marry him into the Liu family as a son-in-law tomorrow.
Hua Wenyue was shocked. It turned out that Chen Jingyan was from the Wu family, but why was he in the Chen family again? How could such a powerful person become a fool?
All these mysteries were shrouded in mist, but they did not allow him to think about it in detail.
After Mrs. Zhang went out, Chen Jingyan picked up the new clothes and took a look. They were very ordinary clothes and were worth no more than three hundred yuan.
He brushed his fingertips over the thick threads at the corners of his clothes and suddenly sneered.
When he was Hua Wenyue, he had a fortune of millions. The clothes he wore were all custom-made, with every stitch and thread sewn by masters. A suit was worth more than a million.
Wearing this coarse linen clothing is simply unsightly.
But now he knows very well that he has been trapped in the stupid body and can only doA fool.
